title: Farshe aza bichao ab majlis e aza hai
body:
FARSHE AZA BICHAO AB MAJLIS-E-AZA HAI
PARCHAM KO SATH LAAO AB MAJLIS-E-AZA HAI
SATH AYENGI TUMHARE HAI JIN KEY TUM SAHARE
ZEHRA KI TUM DUA LOO AB MAJLIS-E-AZA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
PARCHAM KHULA RAHEGA ABBAS-E-BAWAFA KA
MEHSHAR KO AB UTHALO AB MAJLIS-E-AZA HAI
MATAM KARO JARI KA SAQQA-E-KARBALA KA
RUDAD-E-EGHAM SUNAO AB MAJLI-E-AZA HAI
<<DIVIDER>>
NEEDASHT HUE GHAZI MASHK-O-ALAM HAI PYASI
UTHO SAKINA AAO AB MAJLIS-E-AZA HAI
MAJLIS MEIN AYI ZEHRA RUMAL LAAYI ZEHRA
ASHK-E-AZA BAHAO AB MAJLIS-E-AZA HAI.
